nodes.summary: Let $S$ be an odd independent set of a simple graph $G$ and let $v$ be a vertex with $v \notin S$. Then the set of neighbours of $v$ that lie in $S$ is either empty or has an odd number of elements.
nodes.title: Outside vertices see an empty or odd part of an odd independent set

nodes.summary: Let $S$ be an odd independent set of a simple graph $G$ and let $v$ be a vertex with $v \notin S$. Then only finitely many neighbours of $v$ lie in $S$.
nodes.title: Outside vertices have finitely many neighbours in an odd independent set

nodes.summary: If $S$ is an odd independent set of a simple graph $G$, then $S$ is an independent set of $G$: no two distinct vertices of $S$ are adjacent.
nodes.title: Odd independent sets are independent

nodes.summary: The empty set is odd independent in any simple graph.
nodes.title: The empty set is odd independent

nodes.summary: For every vertex $a$ of a simple graph $G$, the singleton $\{a\}$ is odd independent in $G$.
nodes.title: Singletons are odd independent

nodes.summary: A set $S$ of vertices of a simple graph $G$ is odd independent if $S$ is an independent set of $G$ and, for every vertex $v \notin S$, the set of neighbours of $v$ that lie in $S$ is finite and is either empty or has an odd number of elements.
nodes.title: Odd independent set

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
